atomicity.receipts: Each receipt is one append. A real verified upload that also deletes the local archive is one receipt carrying uploaded+verified+local_removed; the model splits it into upload_ok then removed, which backup_facts folds identically (set, then pop local).
atomicity.tick: One evaluate() call reads every fact, then writes the whole persisted state. Facts are read at the tick's hour; receipts appended at the same hour after the tick wait for the next tick.
atomicity.time: Integer logical hours. Ordering kept: Grace <= VacAge < RedSnap < RedOff (real 2 h <= 6 h < 54 h < 78 h). Amber age thresholds are not modelled for backups (amber and green are both not red).
atomicity.canary: CanaryRed is 2 in the model (3 in production); the latch and owed-repayment logic do not depend on the count.
atomicity.focus: PipeVerdict explores one check's world per config (Focus); evaluate() couples checks only through ticked_at/resumed_at, which every config keeps.
atomicity.grace: Wake grace for ingest, embedding and pending stores is one action inside the tick (_graced_age). GraceOnce persists the window per check exactly as S1a-6's keep dict: written only on ticks that run _graced_age, so a cleared or unknown clock drops it.
atomicity.simulation: Conformance cases run TLC -simulate with one worker (num is per worker), 3,000 traces, depth 60, seed 7.
